request: 구성은 끝났으니 바탕, 색감, 타이포그래피, 그림자, 은은한 빛 같은 표면을 잘 포장한다. 방향: 밝게 · 고급스럽고 차분하게 · 은은하게.

captures.provenance: Rendered in headless Chromium from layer-preview.html with every layer off, 2026-09-28. The mockup redraws the user's shared screenshot of the review-analysis app; it is not a capture of the app itself.
captures.state: Palworld, optimization selected, all surface layers off (approximates the user's current screen).

captures.provenance: Rendered in headless Chromium from layer-preview.html with all eight layers on, 2026-09-28, after four rounds of user feedback.
captures.state: Palworld, optimization selected, all surface layers on, 0.9s after load so entrance motion has finished.

comparison_limits: Both captures come from a mockup, not the application; the application's own rendering, fonts, and data can differ.
Scatter coordinates other than optimization, pal design, price, and open world were read by eye from the user's screenshot.
Web fonts were blocked in the capture environment, so Noto Sans KR and Manrope rendered with fallbacks.
Stills cannot show entrance motion or hover; those were checked separately by driving the mouse in Chromium.
user_feedback: Direction chosen through three multiple-choice questions: bright, premium and calm, subtle.
Round 1: canvas, surface, type, and details accepted; color rejected as dated; type readability and the right panel judged weak.
Round 1 reference: the user pointed at non-flat purple bars in another product and asked what the technique is called; the answer was data-mark styling.
Round 3: remove the decorative brand square; make points larger relative to the plot; keep red and blue quadrant zones readable at a glance; do not dim the highlighted topics on hover.

Round 4: the overall proportion was wrong because most topics crowded the left of the plot, and the circle design looked poor. The x-axis moved to a labeled log scale and markers became zone-tinted hollow rings with solid highlighted points.
acceptance_checks: Structure, data values, and copy match the before state, except the chart title the user asked to rename and the x-axis, which moved to a labeled log scale at the user's request.
All eight layers are visibly treated and each can be toggled independently in layer-preview.html.
Highlighted marks stay at full strength while another point is hovered.
Text over gradient or translucent surfaces is checked by eye; the inventory reports it as unresolved.
